newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - October 4.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - October 4.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Friday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Money-laundering bill passes legislature.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Anti-corruption, money-laundering bills passed.
President Lee Teng-hui fears "hollowing-out" of Taiwan industries.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - Controversies on opening telecom market rock legislature.
Two-way money flow between Taiwan and China reaches record $51 million in July.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Taiwan's special trade zone may impose restrictions on China.
Chicago Mercantile Exchange seen postponing Taiwan stock index futures to 1997.
